title: Everything Zaydoun can do with a book.
lead: One reading partner, on the web and in your pocket. Here’s what’s in the box.

f1.title: Answers you can check
f1.body: Zaydoun finds the passages that matter in your PDF, answers from them, and tags the page he leaned on, so you can go and read it yourself.
f1.b1: Searches by meaning, not just matching words
f1.b2: A “Page N” tag on answers that come from a passage
f1.sample: He lays it out as a pattern first, then comes back to what it does to trade.

f2.title: Voice-first, hands-free
f2.body: In the mobile app, say his name and talk. Your voice is transcribed, the answer is read back to you, and the whole exchange is saved to your account.
f2.b2: Spoken answers in your reply language
f2.b3: Voice on the web is on the way
f2.sample: “Zaydoun, what’s his strongest argument in chapter 3?”

f3.title: Five languages, Arabic done right
f3.body: Upload in English, Arabic, French, Spanish or Chinese, and choose the reply language for each conversation. Arabic reads right to left in a proper Arabic typeface.

f4.title: PDF in, conversation out
f4.body: Drop in a PDF up to 50 MB. Zaydoun splits it page by page and builds an index of what’s where. You’ll see each step as it happens.

f5.title: A library that remembers
f5.body: Your books on one shelf, every conversation saved and filterable by book. Reopen a thread from last month and pick up mid-argument.

f6.title: An admin console for teams
f6.body: Admins manage readers, roles and access, and see usage and cost by day and by conversation. Readers just see their books.

f7.title: Private by design
f7.body: Your books and conversations belong to your account alone, and you can delete any of it. To answer you, the relevant passages are sent to OpenAI’s API.

hood.label: Under the hood, for the curious

answers.desc: GPT-4o mini, given the passages it found in your book

accounts.desc: JWT with httpOnly refresh tokens, bcrypt-hashed passwords

isolation.desc: Every query scoped to the signed-in reader
